branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A bottled milk-based drink in banana, chocolate, strawberry and vanilla flavours, made industrially by FrieslandCampina. It is Belgian in origin, launched in the 1960s, and sold in Belgium, France, the UK and Ireland.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
